dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent structures include a large dorsal 'O' with a jagged, high-contrast light-grey perimeter against a dark-grey exterior, and several posterior 'C' shapes with irregular, serrated boundaries. The gradient transitions sharply from dark exterior fur to the light-intensity hair forming the ring perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel blobs clustered around the muzzle and anterior neck. An additional cluster of low-gradient white speckles is located on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the large dorsal-mid 'O' structure, the central-lateral 'O' structure, and the posterior-lateral 'C' structure form an obtuse scalene triangle with the primary axis oriented longitudinally.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, distinct vertically-aligned rectangular pattern of light-intensity lines is visible on the mid-lateral flank.
